errors.text_span: 在每个测试集中，LSTM-HMM模型的EDR值最低
errors.evidence: This statement is an overgeneralization. In Test5, the EDR value for the LSTM-HMM model is tied with the End-to-End model at approximately 13.5%, so it is not uniquely the lowest.
The stated range for the DNN-HMM model is incorrect. The value for this model in Test4 is approximately 24.5%, which falls outside the described 20% to 24% range.
The stated range for the End-to-End model is incorrect. The value for this model in Test3 is approximately 18.5%, which falls outside the described 12% to 18% range.
